threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think wearing a parka in summer is a fashion statement. Everyone else is in shorts, drinking craft beer on the pavement.
Spotted a guy on the 47 loudly reciting Shakespeare to a half-asleep crowd. Everyone pretended not to listen until the encore of Hamlet’s soliloquy.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw a kid selling homemade lemonade on the corner of Richardstraße, while a busker played 'Wonderwall' nearby. Classic Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, it’s common to see street artists using public transport as a stage—performing on trams while commuters pretend to ignore them.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a true local when they know to avoid BART during rush hour, especially with all the brake problems lately. Tourists just stand there, confused.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy juggling at the 16th St BART while the train was delayed, completely unbothered by the chaos. Just another day in the Mission.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the parks are just for lounging, but we use them for morning markets and impromptu concerts too. It’s a different vibe.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still ask for 'tap water' at restaurants instead of just asking for a 'carafeta.' It's a dead giveaway.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it 'the Tube' instead of 'the Overground' for anything that doesn’t go underground. Classic rookie mistake.
Caught the 35 last night, and a group of blokes were discussing their failed attempts to woo the same girl. One even recited a Shakespeare sonnet. On a night bus!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted the guy in a full suit, juggling while waiting for a U-Bahn, as if it were the most normal Tuesday in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you see complete strangers sharing a table at a Späti, sipping their drinks while the latest political debate echoes from the nearby Kiezbeisl.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can always spot a real local; they’re the ones who know the exact order to hit the tacos at La Taqueria right before closing.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo ride the 47 while eating a burrito. Muni really is the great equalizer; fancy and funky all at once.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Most tourists think all plazas are just for photos, but locals use places like Plaça del Sol to catch up with friends over a vermut, not for selfies.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They’re the ones at the terrace still asking for a ‘small coffee’ instead of a ‘cafè petit’—and looking mildly confused when it doesn’t come in a to-go cup.
